intro: FDDI Rae Bareli is in Amethi and Shiv Nadar University is in Noida. This page compares their recorded M.Tech / M.E. fees, placements, admission routes and campuses for 2026.

FDDI Rae Bareli vs Shiv Nadar University is not a single winner. FDDI Rae Bareli is recorded as a public institute, while Shiv Nadar University is private. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: FDDI Rae Bareli vs Shiv Nadar University for M.Tech / M.E.: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose FDDI Rae Bareli if you want a public M.Tech / M.E. option and the admission route and fees that usually come with a government or state university campus.
Choose Shiv Nadar University if a private campus, its specific specialisation or its recorded placement year fits your plan better, after you have checked the official fee notice.

FDDI Rae Bareli lists M.Tech / M.E. - CAD, M.Tech / M.E. - Footwear Design & Production. Shiv Nadar University lists M.Tech Chemical Engineering, M.Tech Civil Engineering, M.Tech Computer Science & Engineering and more.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.

Our records list ₹1.28 lakh a year as tuition fees for FDDI Rae Bareli's M.Tech / M.E. - Footwear Design & Production. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.

Our records list ₹1 lakh a year as tuition fees for Shiv Nadar University's M.Tech Mechanical Engineering. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Our records do not show a 2020 or later flagship placement year for FDDI Rae Bareli on this page. Ask the institute for its latest official placement report for the same programme.
Our records do not show a 2020 or later flagship placement year for Shiv Nadar University on this page. Ask the institute for its latest official placement report for the same programme.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for FDDI Rae Bareli on this M.Tech / M.E. page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.
Shiv Nadar University's recorded admission tests on this page include GATE.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: FDDI Rae Bareli is recorded in Amethi, Uttar Pradesh, and Shiv Nadar University is in Noida, Delhi NCR.
If you have a strong city preference, let that lead, then compare fees and the admission test for the same programme.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want the stronger recorded public standing or NIRF rank in this pair, FDDI Rae Bareli is the safer first pick, after you have checked official fees and seats.
Shiv Nadar University can still be the better fit if its specialisation, city or recorded fee level matches what you can join this year.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.
